name: Microsoft Office
summary: The document window of Word, Excel and PowerPoint for Windows: Ctrl combinations and F12 run the document's commands, Alt shows key tips on the ribbon, each tooltip shows a command's keys, and closing a changed document asks whether to save it.

shortcuts.label: ショートカット メニュー

confirm.close_sentence: このファイルの変更内容を保存しますか?

keys.shortcuts.label: ショートカット メニュー

evidence.source: Microsoft サポート, Word のキーボード ショートカット (ja-jp)
evidence.says: Ctrl+O opens a document, Ctrl+N creates one, Ctrl+S saves it and Ctrl+W closes it; Ctrl+X, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V cut, copy and paste; Ctrl+A selects all the content; Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+Y redoes the last action; F12 opens the 名前を付けて保存 dialog; F6 switches between the document, the task pane, the status bar and the ribbon; Shift+F10 shows the shortcut menu of the selection; Ctrl+H finds and replaces; Ctrl+F1 expands or collapses the ribbon; Alt or F10 selects the active tab and turns on the access keys.

evidence.source: Microsoft Support, Keyboard shortcuts in Word (en-us)
evidence.says: F10 alone turns the KeyTips on or off, Ctrl+P prints the document, and Ctrl+F opens the Navigation pane to search the document.

evidence.source: Microsoft サポート, PowerPoint のキーボード ショートカット (ja-jp)
evidence.says: Ctrl+F opens the [検索] dialog and Ctrl+H the [置換] dialog; Ctrl+P prints, Ctrl+S saves and Ctrl+Q closes PowerPoint; Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+Y repeats the last action; Ctrl+F1 expands or collapses the ribbon.

evidence.source: Microsoft Support, Use the keyboard to work with the ribbon
evidence.says: Alt shows the KeyTips and puts the focus on the selected tab; Esc goes back one KeyTip step; Alt+F opens the File page and Alt+H the Home tab; F6 moves the focus between the active tab, the document, the task pane and the status bar.

evidence.source: Microsoft Support, Keyboard shortcuts in Excel
evidence.says: Ctrl+W closes a workbook and Ctrl+O opens one.

evidence.source: Microsoft Learn, Dialog Boxes - Win32 apps
evidence.says: Commit buttons sit right-aligned in one row at the bottom, the positive response first, then the negative, then Cancel; every dialog has a default commit button; Paint's prompt on unsaved changes offers Save, Don't Save, which closes without saving, and Cancel, which cancels the command.
Shortcut keys are documented in menu bar items, in toolbar tooltips and in one Help article; context menus do not show them.

evidence.source: Microsoft 365 Word, Excel and PowerPoint 16.0.20625 for Windows, read through UI Automation
evidence.says: The quick access toolbar shows 上書き保存 (Ctrl+S), 元に戻す and やり直し (Ctrl+Y); the ribbon shows 貼り付け, 切り取り and コピー; the file view lists 新規, 開く, 上書き保存, 名前を付けて保存, 印刷, エクスポート and 閉じる, and its help button takes F1; closing a changed document shows 「このファイルの変更内容を保存しますか?」 with the buttons 保存 (Alt+S), 保存しない (Alt+N) and キャンセル.
